_note: Tracked federal cases read from CourtListener by the court-docket step (publish/courts.mjs): entry key -> the court and CourtListener's docket id. A second docket for the same entry (an appeal) uses any name with an entry_key. Material docket entries become Litigation events; orders, judgments, opinions and appeals also news items. Every litigation entry that is still active must be here or in _not_followed with the reason (schema/tracking.mjs checks it on every pull request).

_not_followed.florida-v-openai-injunction-motion: The federal docket (S.D. Fla.) closed when the case was remanded on Sept 8, 2026; the case is in Highlands County Circuit Court, which has no public API and is not on CourtListener.
_not_followed.california-ag-v-openai-agent-cyberattack: Filed in San Francisco Superior Court, a state court that CourtListener does not carry and that has no public API.
